block-report.why: One Adamic block's own build and tests at its commit, run sealed on a rented machine with no network, no root, no token and no loom, as a report read by hand beside the house's decided run of the same commit. It isn't the house's build of the tree: it makes no keys and compares none, and nothing it says lands, charges or clears (#highfive, piece 6, Node's road 3).
